description: MiniMax-H3-Image editing and generation from one or more reference pictures. 'images' is a list of 1 or more; the prompt names them one-based in list order, <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and so on (FLUX 3 Klein's multi-reference names them zero-based, <ref_image_0>, so a Klein prompt does not carry over). A single-image edit is a list of one: say what to keep in <Picture 1>, then what to change. Give each reference a role and say what stays as it is. The vendor states up to 16 references; the pipeline does not enforce a cap, and three is what has been timed here. A reference keeps its own pixels when its short edge is 1024 to 2048 and is resized into that range otherwise; it needs at least 32 pixels per side. The output canvas is 'width' x 'height', not the reference's size. 'size' picks a canvas: 2048 (the default, 2048x2048, about 4 MP, the size the cost was measured at) or one of the vendor's recommended sizes of about 16 MP - 1:1 4096x4096, 4:3 4736x3552, 3:2 5024x3360, 16:9 5472x3072, 21:9 6272x2688 and their portrait swaps (3:4, 2:3, 9:16, 9:21); the 16 MP sizes have not been timed on a 24 GB card. Pass width and height for any other size, both multiples of 32. A canvas under about 4 MP is generated at about 4 MP at the same aspect ratio and resized back (the pipeline's default minimum generation area), so 1024x1024 is no faster than 2048x2048. The checkpoint is distilled to a fixed 6-step sampler with its guidance baked in: it takes no step count, guidance scale or negative prompt, and the template declares none. CUDA only. The recipe is int8 SDNQ on the transformer and the text encoder, with group offload, so it needs under 6 GB of VRAM but about 64 GB of host RAM warm (host_ram_gb 64); a cold first run on a host without the quantized cache peaks at about 120 GB of host RAM (117 GB measured) while it quantizes, and the first download is about 64 GiB. The text encoder is loaded from MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 at the commit the H3 templates pin, so it shares H3's quantized cache.
summary: MiniMax-H3-Image edit or composition from 1 or more references named <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>...

variables.prompt: The woman from <Picture 1> and the man from <Picture 2> sit across from each other at a small table in the setting shown in <Picture 3>, leaning in as if mid-conversation. Keep each face, hairstyle and build exactly as in their portraits; keep the frozen-lake setting, its dusk light and its colour grade exactly as in <Picture 3>. Photographic, natural skin texture, medium two-shot at eye level, both faces clearly visible.

width.reason: MiniMax-H3-Image's canvas is a multiple of 32 (the VAE's 16x compression times the transformer's 2x2 patch), and its pipeline refuses one that is not only after the weights have loaded; refused here instead, with no 'snap', since rounding would be a silent change to the size asked for
